fields.Institution: Sri Sharada Institute of Indian Management Research
fields.Approval / Accreditation: AICTE approval status to be verified for current intake
fields.Fees — Published: Current official PGDM annual charges ₹55,000 day-scholar/₹95,000 hosteller, plus ₹4,900 one-time and ₹20,000 refundable security. Implied two-year nonrefundable total ₹1.149 L day/₹1.949 L hostel, if annual charges unchanged. No separate tuition head shown.
fields.Fee Scope: Official page: one-time 4900; annual 95000 hosteller or 55000 day scholar; refundable security 20000. Tuition is not itemised. Do not present 119900/79900 first-payment totals or two annual cycles as a complete PGDM fee.
fields.CAT / Exam Cutoff: CAT accepted / cutoff not officially disclosed
fields.Eligibility: Graduation from a recognised university/institution with at least 50% marks for postgraduate management programmes (official admission-procedure page).
fields.Selection Process: Merit and holistic assessment of past academics, co-curricular achievements, work experience, written/aptitude test and personal interview. Admissions Committee sets parameter weights; two-level application/document scrutiny.
fields.Highest CTC — Published: No highest disclosed in official 2023-25 table; legacy third-party ₹8 L unconfirmed
fields.Placement — Published: 100% of students placed,45 companies (official 2023-25 claim; denominator absent)
fields.Top Recruiters: Aditya Birla, Cognizant, Honeywell, Tech Mahindra, SIFY (third-party)
fields.Programme-Aligned Career Paths: Business/Strategy Consultant; Product/Program Manager; Operations; Sales/Brand; Finance Analyst
fields.Notes: Recovered official 2023-25 placement table (mean 5.7 L,45 companies) and current fee schedule. Legacy secondary fee 4.5 L conflicts materially; current official fee has no tuition line, so extrapolation is conditional and requires admissions confirmation.
